capabilities: Draw the vault as a 3D galaxy where each folder is a star system
Replay the vault's creation history note by note with Genesis
Inspect, open, route between, and mind-map notes from the view
Export photo cards, posters, and MP4 clips of the vault
Add an Orrery view to Bases and a mini orrery to the sidebar
extras: Desktop only, requires WebGL. Makes zero network requests at runtime and documents how to verify this. Shows a one-time GitHub star prompt after updates. Free browser demo on the project page works without installing. Docs link out for privacy, performance, and development details.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows the vault as flat dots without folder structure or a way to see how the vault grew over time.
summary: 3D graph view that draws the vault as a galaxy of folder star systems with notes in orbit, replays its creation history, and exports shareable images.
